t: This is Drury Lane, a street running between Aldwych and High Holborn, right on the boundary between Covent Garden and Holborn. The northern part falls in Camden and the southern part in Westminster, and the street is part of London's West End Theatreland. Over the years it has had some varied residents. Anne Cornwallis, countess of Argyll, a Roman Catholic benefactor, died here. Captain James Neale, an early emigrant to Maryland, was born here. And a man named Gabriell Truman lived here.
